column1: # OPS-CI-PR-TRAILER-RANGE-001 — post-merge branch-ci.yml run audit
# Source : GitHub Actions API,
#          repos/ajoe734/pantheon/actions/workflows/branch-ci.yml/runs
#          lower bound = PR #4217 merged_at, upper bound = last run of the
#          audited fleet burst. Both bounds inclusive.
# Rows   : every run in the window, no sampling, no truncation. 53 runs.
# head_has_fix_merge    : `git merge-base --is-ancestor 71aea154b <head_sha>`
#                         i.e. does the run's head commit already contain the
#                         PR #4217 merge?
# workflow_file_version : which branch-ci.yml / resolver actually executed,
#                         read out of the run's `Commit trailers` job log.
#                         `repaired` = the job printed the new
#                         `[range] event=... resolved=...` line.
#                         `pre-fix`  = no `[range]` line; the range was taken
#                         from the pre-#4217 resolver invocation.
#                         A `pull_request` run is `repaired` even when its head
#                         predates the merge, because GitHub runs the workflow
#                         file from refs/pull/N/merge (base + head), and dev
#                         already carried the fix.
# resolved_range        : the range handed to check_commit_trailers.py.
